query: Fresh-eyes comparison after twenty rendered cycles: does the current M51 field guide preserve subject truth, source continuity, reading distance, and a complete result context?

findings.observation: The earlier frame presented a source identity that did not match the actual image and left the relation between the image, note, and record ambiguous.
findings.consequence: The guide could feel like a generic dark treatment because the material truth was not legible at the moment of reading.
findings.repair: Use two explicitly identified records of the same M51 encounter, show the active record beside the state, connect the field note to the core state, and preserve both records in the source band.

findings.observation: The prior title was oversized relative to a weak wide-field subject, while the actual galaxy remained too small to carry the opening.
findings.consequence: The first read had poster hierarchy without a clear product subject.
findings.repair: Lead with the inspected Hubble subject, reduce the title ceiling, and keep the next section visible at the bottom of the first viewport.

findings.observation: At the narrow viewport the primary destinations and the continuation link competed for the same vertical space.
findings.consequence: The entry route became cramped and the next action could overlap supporting copy.
findings.repair: Keep the three destinations visible with compact touch-safe type and place the continuation action in its own row below the hero copy.

findings.observation: The first result layout pushed the reading controls below the viewport while the image occupied the full width.
findings.consequence: A user could see the image but not the action that changes the reading distance.
findings.repair: Use a two-column instrument at desktop widths so the source image, state controls, record identity, and explanatory copy are visible in one result context.

largestGap: The comparison is bounded to the M51 field-guide brief; it does not establish excellence across unrelated future briefs or parity with a live reference.
nextOperation: Run the same subject-to-source audit on the next generated brief before fine polish.
regressionCheck: Repeat 1280x720, 390x844, 320x740, wide/pair/core source switches, reduced-motion, and induced-image-failure checks.

contract.purpose: Provide a fresh, severity-ranked visual judgment before a meaningful round is accepted.
